hook.name: wASSBLASTER420
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the wASS token that charges a 0.7% fee on the wASS side of every swap, distributing fees equally between an Apple Staking contract and the protocol owner. Registered market makers are exempt from fees; fee capture uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta for wASS sells and afterSwapReturnsDelta for wASS buys.
